$comment: Central registry of feature prerequisites (issue #25). Consumed by hooks/check-prereqs.mjs (SessionStart notice), the project-initializer agent (init/update-time check), and skills that need install hints. Add an entry here whenever a feature gains an external requirement — never hardcode prerequisite checks in individual skills or hooks. An entry may carry a `requiredWhen` gate {config: <dotted path in agenticaiplugin.config.json>, equals: <value>} so a prerequisite for an opt-in feature is only probed when that feature is enabled.

features: all plugin hooks (SessionStart, PostToolUse, Stop, UserPromptSubmit)

hints.win32: winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS  — new shells only: restart Claude Code afterwards
hints.linux: distro packages often lag behind LTS — install Node 22+ via nvm ('nvm install 22') or NodeSource (https://github.com/nodesource/distributions)

features: autoskill automatic background skill review and the curator's LLM overlap analysis (the manual /agenticaiplugin:learn and the curator's deterministic lifecycle still work without it)

hints.win32: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code  (the Claude Code CLI must be on PATH for the background reviewer)

features: npm-publisher (creates GitHub releases via `gh release create`)
pr-review-setup (the human setup step stores the repo secret via `gh secret set`)
handover (optional cross-check against `gh pr list` / `gh issue list` — degrades gracefully without it)

hints.linux: distro packages often lag behind current releases — install via the official repo (https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/docs/install_linux.md) or your package manager

features: code-review (dependency-deprecation checks query package registries via `curl`)

hints.win32: included since Windows 10 1803+; older builds: winget install cURL.cURL
hints.linux: install via your package manager (e.g. apt install curl / dnf install curl) if not already present
hints.darwin: preinstalled on macOS — brew install curl for a newer version

features: npm-publisher (unpacks the built tarball for a pre-publish content audit via `tar -xzf`)

hints.win32: included since Windows 10 1803+ (bsdtar); older builds: use WSL or install via winget
hints.linux: preinstalled on virtually all distros; install via your package manager otherwise (e.g. apt install tar)
